static_traits.name: Chen Tao
static_traits.occupation: Proofreader at a greeting card company
static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友，但not yet向他们谈及自身的“毫without价值感”；因自我not足感与朋友关系有所紧张
static_traits.medical_history: not yet经历类似心理问题；既往not yet接受心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病

basic_info.main_problem: 因为仍Lives with parents而感到not够好与毫without价值，尤其在与Living alone的朋友相处或谈到居住情况时这种感受更强。
basic_info.core_demands: not断加重的“毫without价值/not够好”感受已影响自尊与整体情绪，希望通过咨询获得支持。
growth_experiences: 父母婚姻稳定已达40年，自己长期Lives with parents。近期因社会对独立的期待以及朋友关于独立生活的评论而进行比较，trigger并加重了自我“not足/毫without价值”的感受，尤其在社交活动或谈论居住情况后反复出现。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not值得

special_situations.event: 朋友提到独立生活的评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能Lives independently，就说明我失败、not够好。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试理性化并对Lives with parents心怀感恩，但仍回避与朋友讨论该话题。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，I am worthless。

special_situations.event: 与已Living alone的朋友相处或在社交场合谈论居住情况
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我还Lives with parents而朋友已经Living alone，就表明我not如他们。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Social withdrawal，减少与朋友和兴趣爱好的接触。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not成熟、看not起我。

special_situations.event: 老板提出周末加班的要求
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我拒绝，就会被认为not够投入，可能丢掉工作。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免与老板谈界限，默认接受安排。

special_situations.event: 想到父母婚姻40年且not yet能度假，并联想到自己仍Lives with parents
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我仍Lives with parents，就说明我是一个not用的儿子。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以感恩来Rationalization现状，但持续negate自身价值。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a valuable son and an independent adult
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被他人（朋友、上司）视为not够好、Being rejected或遭受负面后果
defense_goal: Maintains safety and others' approval through compliance and avoiding conflict

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、依赖的儿子/成年人
object_relations.object_representation: 他人（朋友、上司）是评判者、拒绝者
The parents are stable and successful role models (implicit comparison objects)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the boss proposes weekend overtime or boundaries are suggested
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方会因我的拒绝negate我或惩罚我（移情：将内在not安投向外界评判）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 避免直接拒绝，用含糊委婉的表达与迎合的语气回应，尽量not触碰冲突。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被建议向朋友表达困扰或寻求支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If speaking up will trouble friends and be looked down on (transference: fearing that exposing vulnerability will damage relationships)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以“我not该麻烦do not人”为由拒绝行动，语气自责，避免作出具体承诺。

manifestations: 将社会对独立的期待内化为自我标准（“应该Living alone”）
难以设定边界，担心拒绝会带来惩罚
Lives with parents引发自我价值质疑
outcomes: Self-deprecation and a sense of shame

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以社会对独立的期待作为自我价值的硬性标准（“我应该Living alone”）
将他人评价作为自我衡量的依据

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 避免与老板直接讨论周末加班
Withdraws from external contact, reduces participation with friends and interest activities (running, games)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: not愿向朋友表达困扰，担心“麻烦do not人”

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends（虽not yet主动求助）
工作能力与岗位基本稳定
主动寻求咨询支持，态度积极
能尝试用理性化与感恩的视角看待Lives with parents
negative_force: 将社会期待Introjection为刚性自我标准，过度依赖外部评价
Hard to set boundaries; avoids direct communication with authority/others
灾难化预测后果（拒绝=Unemployment/被negate）
Social withdrawal与Sleep disturbance导致功能下降
自我标签化与negate（“not用的儿子”）

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与老板沟通并难以说“not”
antecedent: 老板提出周末加班的请求
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries that refusal will be punished or cost the job, catastrophic prediction of negative outcomes and dependence on external recognition
target_behavior.function: 逃避冲突与潜在惩罚，维持他人认可
target_behavior.consequence: 工作-生活失衡、Persistent anxiety与Decreased attention

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal，减少与朋友和兴趣爱好的参与
antecedent: 社交活动后或谈论居住情况的话题
与已Living alone的朋友相处时的比较
target_behavior.core_reason: 羞耻与自我贬低（认为not如他人），担心被看轻
target_behavior.function: 避免暴露于评价与羞耻情境
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends、情绪与Decreased motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbance（入睡困难/Declining sleep quality）
antecedent: Anticipation周末加班与边界设定的压力
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent anxiety与高唤醒，围绕自我价值与外部评价的担心
target_behavior.function: 虽非有意的功能，但体现过度警觉和not yet解决的压力维持
target_behavior.consequence: 白天精力与专注下降，进一步加重Low mood与工作压力
